2403-3220-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-3220-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-3905-4247.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3905-4247.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1580-2438-4871-6887.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

779-4970-5751-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
779-4970-5751-7693.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-5147-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-5147-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Rowan, Scholar of Sparks // Will, Scholar of Frost

877-1374-5910-7644.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Rowan or Will and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

3175-4775-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

5256-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5256-6887-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

814-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-4359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

369-2730-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2919-3188-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3188-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-2478-6912.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Mishra's Bauble.
Cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Flash Thompson.
When Flash Thompson enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

647-1170-1329-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2653-5702-6753-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-5702-6753-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve the Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

147-5256-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5256-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5256-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

2146-5078-6918.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

997-4435-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
997-4435-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2060-2577-3967-6431.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3769-5231-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
3769-5231-5434-5555.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

1061-1379-2043.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
1061-1379-2043.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator that is a 1/1 Soldier creature.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1766-2645-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Thran Dynamo's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
1766-2645-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

1722-4050-4616.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Moldervine Reclamation, causing you to gain 1 life and drawing you a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.
